data.overview: An incarcerated man serving time for a crime he denies discovers a sense of purpose in a prison theatre troupe. Alongside other inmates, he prepares a stage production that offers the men a chance to be seen beyond their sentences.
data.tagline: A role can open a door.
data.title: Theatre Behind the Walls
